body.x: Miraxess participated in the “CES 2018 Unveiled” which opened on Sunday, January 7, 2018 in Las Vegas, USA to present Mirabook.

Mirabook is a function-extension product which can add all the functions of the laptop to a smartphone. In other words, over the smartphone, the consumer can use all the functions of the laptop such as full HD displays, keyboards, touchpads, storage devices, large-capacity batteries.

MIrabook is an ultralight consumer-adjustable product finished with aluminum. Its screen size is 13.3 inches diagonally, and it features a resolution of Full HD. Its battery can be used continuously maximum 24 hours while the smartphone is being charged from it. The battery is also quite and does not get overheated.

It can be utilized easily and is practical. You can connect it to a smartphone through the Type-C USB in order to move the screen of the smartphone into the big screen. As all the apps and data is managed by the smartphone in a centralized way, data synchronization is not needed anymore.

CES, the world's largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
